value: Act on Residential Leases (asuinhuoneiston vuokrauslaki) 481/1995; the consolidated text read shows amendments up to 16.6.2026/531.
A term requiring security greater than three months of rent is void (section 8).
Security must be returned or released, or a written notice of withholding given, without delay and at the latest within 14 days of the end of the lease or of handing over possession (section 8).

When the landlord terminates, the notice period is four months if the tenancy has lasted at least two years immediately before termination, otherwise three months; terms shortening the landlord's notice period are void (section 52).
When the tenant terminates, the notice period is one month (section 52).
